summary: Reproduced and fixed the reported cart WHITE SCREEN bug — plus discovered and fixed a SECOND white-screen (TDZ) in CheckoutPage that would have appeared as soon as the CartPage crash was cleared. Auth guard verified working. COD gate verified for all three cart scenarios.
action_items: Please review my two fixes below — both were standard coding bugs blocking the flows the review asked me to test. If you prefer a different pattern (e.g. making trackAction actually return a Promise in TrackingProvider so the .catch chain works everywhere), that would be a more systemic solution.
critical_code_review_comments: TrackingProvider.trackAction (line 133) returns undefined but MULTIPLE consumers call .catch on it. CartPage.js:41 was the crash source that produced the white cart screen the user reported. Consider changing trackAction to `return queueEvent(action, data);` or `return Promise.resolve();` so every existing `.catch(() => {})` call site becomes safe. Grep other pages (Homepage, ProductDetailPage, CheckoutPage) — they only call trackAction without .catch today, so the immediate bug is only CartPage, but the API contract is a footgun.

CheckoutPage.js had a temporal-dead-zone bug: the auto-flip useEffect (originally around line 70) referenced `pinInfo` which is declared later (line 90). React actually caught this on mount → ReferenceError: Cannot access 'pinInfo' before initialization → SECOND white screen on /checkout. This was NOT the setState-during-render bug the main agent thought they fixed — the previous IIFE approach was replaced with a useEffect, but it was placed above the state it depends on. Moved useEffect to right AFTER `setPinInfo` declaration.
General TDZ hygiene: recommend keeping all useState declarations grouped at the top of the component and putting useEffect/useMemo blocks below them, so this class of bug can't recur.
AdminLayout auth guard (AppRouter.js:109-128) works exactly as designed — verified in fresh browser context, /admin/offers redirects to /admin login immediately, no admin content leaked.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/pages/CartPage.js — line 41: `trackAction(...).catch(...)` → wrapped in try/catch since trackAction returns void
/app/frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.js — moved the codAvailable auto-flip useEffect from before the pinInfo useState to right after it, fixing TDZ ReferenceError

success_rate.backend: 100% (payment-policy GET public, PUT admin-guarded, both verified)

seed_data_creation: PUT /api/admin/payment-policy cod_restriction_enabled=true during tests, reset to false at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State at handoff: cod_restriction_enabled reset to FALSE, sale mode was ON when this run started and left ON (was ON before my changes too — /admin/offers UI showed 'ACTIVE — every anti-aging product shows the sale price'). If you need to test the COD-hidden path (skincare + NON-warehouse pincode), the location modal on /checkout auto-opens and blocks direct input into the pincode field via keyboard — use `Change delivery location` in the header and search for e.g. 'Connaught Place, Delhi 110001' to seed a non-instant pincode, THEN load /cart → /checkout. Once pinInfo.coverage.instant_available is false and cart has skincare, [data-testid='cod-unavailable-note'] appears and [data-testid='pay-method-cod'] is absent — the source logic (CheckoutPage.js codAvailable + canCOD memo) already handles this correctly.
rca of the issue: Cart white screen: TrackingProvider.trackAction is a fire-and-forget void function (calls queueEvent and returns nothing). CartPage.js added a `.catch(() => {})` chain onto that undefined result inside a useEffect on mount, so every render of /cart threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'catch')` and React's error boundary unmounted the tree — hence WHITE SCREEN. This was NOT related to the COD toggle at all — the toggle just happens to be enabled around the same time the cart is next visited. Fix: wrap in try/catch, drop the .catch chain. Checkout white screen: separate TDZ ReferenceError from useEffect referencing pinInfo before its useState declaration. The main agent's summary said they 'moved setState-during-render to a proper useEffect', but the useEffect was placed above pinInfo, so React threw immediately on mount. Fix: move useEffect below pinInfo's useState. Auth guard: no issue, working as designed — /admin/offers with no adminToken redirects instantly to /admin login with zero admin content leak, verified in fresh browser context.
